description: This PHP file renders and manages the 'Edit View' interface for documents in a vtiger CRM module. It handles retrieving existing document data, setting up the form with relevant information, managing other contextual data, and rendering the appropriate Smarty templates for creating or editing documents.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: Base class for CRM entity instances, providing methods like getInstance() for retrieving entity objects.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine class used for rendering views.

methods.name: vtlib_purify
methods.description: Sanitizes input data for security and safety.

methods.name: CRMEntity::getInstance
methods.description: Returns an instance of the CRM entity class corresponding to the current module.

methods.name: getBasic_Advance_SearchURL
methods.description: Generates the URL for basic or advanced search functionality.

methods.name: getRecordOwnerId
methods.description: Retrieves owner information for a given record or parent entity.

methods.name: setObjectValuesFromRequest
methods.description: Populates the focus object with data from the request.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Determines the current view mode (edit, detail, etc.).

methods.name: getBlocks
methods.description: Fetches the blocks (sections) to display in the view for the current module.

methods.name: getParentTab
methods.description: Retrieves the parent tab category for the module.

methods.name: updateInfo
methods.description: Provides update information for the current entity.

methods.name: vt_hasRTE
methods.description: Checks whether Rich Text Editor (RTE) is enabled.

methods.name: getFieldVisibilityPermission
methods.description: Checks if a field is visible for the current user.

methods.name: getTabid
methods.description: Retrieves the tab ID for a given module.

methods.name: split_validationdataArray
methods.description: Splits validation data into fieldname, datatype, and label components.

methods.name: getDBValidationData
methods.description: Fetches validation data for a module's fields from the database.

methods.name: getModuleSequenceField
methods.description: Retrieves sequence field info for the module, if any.

methods.name: getTranslatedString
methods.description: Retrieves localized strings for UI display.

methods.name: vtlib_getFieldHelpInfo
methods.description: Fetches help info for fields in the module.

methods.name: Vtiger_DependencyPicklist::getPicklistDependencyDatasource
methods.description: Gets data about picklist field dependencies for the module.
